canonical_title: Nvidia and major asset managers assemble a $500 billion AI infrastructure financing venture
aliases: Nvidia Wall Street AI infrastructure fund
treatment: Treat the reported $500 billion infrastructure-financing consortium as covered. Reinclude only for signed commitments, named projects, capital structure, deployment schedule, changes in participants, or official NVIDIA/partner confirmation with material new detail.
known_facts: Reuters reported on August 10 at 16:34 UTC that financial firms including Apollo and Blackstone are working with NVIDIA on a roughly $500 billion financing package for AI infrastructure.
The consortium also includes BlackRock Global Infrastructure Partners, Brookfield Asset Management, Goldman Sachs and KKR, according to the reporting.
The capital is intended to support chips, power generation and data-center infrastructure underpinning AI build-out.
The arrangement was still described as being in talks rather than a fully closed financing package at publication time.
reinclude_only_if: NVIDIA or consortium members formally announce the vehicle or binding commitments.
Specific data-center, power, chip-purchase or financing projects are disclosed.
The size, capital structure, participant list or deployment timeline materially changes.
Regulatory filings or financing documents reveal material terms.
notes: NEW in the 2026-08-11 Midday window; Reuters publication time 2026-08-10 16:34 UTC = 2026-08-11 01:34 JST.
